race.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Handicap
race.verdict: ANTHROPOLOGIST has thrived here of late and might be able to defy the handicapper again. Tex added to his many good turf efforts this year when third in a big field at Newmarket at the end of October and heads the dangers along with Zryan , who is well treated back from a break, and the selection's stablemate Raging Raj . ANTHROPOLOGIST TEX (FR) ZRYAN (FR)
